The '''harvap''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nim Drovis]], though it spread throughout [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] after the [[Species/Legends|species]] was discovered and named by [[Jarn Harvus]]. Harvaps were originally carrion-eaters, though they later adapted by incorporating industrial waste and garbage into its diet as they became populous on heavily-industrialized worlds. They were especially numerous in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the planet [[Quesh]] led to the evolution of an exceptionally hardy variety of harvaps that were able to survive the poisonous atmosphere.<ref name="Codex" /> One of their adaptations to assist with this was that their lungs contained specialized microbes that could filter radioactive gases.<ref name="Calibrations">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Good Calibrations|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>
